candidates.description: This feature vector activates common grammatical conjunctions and connecting words across different languages.
This vector represents common Thai grammatical particles, prepositions, and conjunctions used to structure sentences.
This vector represents sports-related terminology, specifically terms associated with throwing, hitting, or pitching in various games and activities.
This feature vector represents three-digit numbers, predominantly in the 170s through 190s range.
This feature vector activates strongly for Thai text tokens and words related to cricket, particularly referencing the Marylebone Cricket Club (MCC).
This feature vector activates on Thai vowel markers and common Thai sub-word character sequences, frequently appearing in tokenized Thai text.
This feature vector activates on a random assortment of subword tokens from multiple languages, particularly Thai and English, with no discernible semantic theme.
This vector activates for tokens related to the International Cricket Council (ICC) and mixed-script text, particularly Thai characters and English fragments.
This feature activates for terms related to international, global, or cross-border entities and concepts across multiple languages.
This feature vector is dormant, malfunctioning, or composed of unrelated token noise with no cohesive semantic concept.
